_comment: Codex skill selection + Codex-tuned descriptions for this plugin. Consumed by stromy-org/scripts/sync-codex-plugin-skills.py, which renders .codex-plugin/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. EDIT THIS FILE, then run ./scripts/sync.sh codex-skills.
_why_separate: Codex caps its skill inventory at ~2% of the context window (8000 chars when unknown) and shortens or drops descriptions past that. This plugin's Claude-side skills/ carries 30 skills / 20260 chars of name+description -- roughly 2.5x over. .codex-plugin/plugin.json points `skills` at .codex-plugin/skills, which REPLACES the default skills/ root in Codex's loader (codex-rs/core-plugins/src/loader.rs :: plugin_skill_roots), so these descriptions are read ONLY by Codex and the Claude routing surface in skills/ is left untouched.

format-guide.description: Product guide for Stromy deliverables -- what to ask for, which format to pick, and what each render skill produces. Use when someone is unsure which format skill fits, or is new to the deliverable tooling.

format-prepare-document.description: Plan a multi-section document before anything is rendered. Use FIRST when a branded PPTX, DOCX or PDF needs a section structure; hand the signed-off envelope to a format-* render skill. Not a renderer itself.

format-pptx-hd.description: Create a NEW branded deck when a client charter exists -- server-rendered PPTX in the brand fonts. Use for pitch, investor, executive and ordinary branded decks. Do NOT use to edit or analyse an existing deck; that is format-pptx.

format-pptx.description: Default PPTX skill: unbranded new decks, plus editing, analysis, OOXML, comments and speaker notes on any EXISTING deck. Use when a deck already exists or no brand is required.

format-pdf-hd.description: Create a NEW branded PDF from HTML with the full web stack -- reports, one-pagers, proposals. Use when the PDF must carry the client brand. Not for reading or editing an existing PDF.

format-pdf.description: Read, extract, merge, split and manipulate EXISTING PDF files, including text and table extraction. Use for PDF surgery, not for authoring a branded document.

format-docx.description: Create, read and edit Word .docx files. Use on any mention of a Word doc, .docx, tracked changes, or a document that must open natively in Word.

format-xlsx.description: Create, edit and analyse spreadsheets -- formulas, formatting, charts, data analysis. Use for .xlsx, Excel, or tabular data work.

format-html-hd.description: Author a premium, fully self-contained branded HTML slide deck -- one .html file. Use when the client wants a web-openable deck rather than PowerPoint.

format-html-reveal.description: Create a self-contained reveal.js HTML deck -- one downloadable .html with brand fonts and images embedded. Use for a presentable, shareable web deck.

format-chart.description: Render brand-aware Plotly data-visualisation charts. Use when a chart is needed on its own or to embed in another deliverable.

format-diagram.description: Generate branded diagrams -- process flows, architecture views, stakeholder maps, org charts, timelines, funnels. Use when a concept needs a picture inside a branded deliverable.

format-mermaid.description: Create Mermaid diagrams for Markdown-based docs (GitHub, GitLab, wikis, blogs). Use when the diagram must stay as text in Markdown rather than a rendered image.

format-motion.description: Author brand-aware motion across HTML surfaces -- animated decks and web pages. Use when a deliverable needs movement rather than a static page.

format-video-hd.description: Author a premium branded explainer video -- a server-rendered MP4 with animated titles and kinetic text. Use when the ask is a video, not a deck.

format-i18n.description: Keep a deliverable's language versions from drifting apart. Use when a document exists in several languages and you need to know exactly what changed where.

do-guide.description: Guia de inicio para investigar el gobierno, el gasto publico y la legislacion de Republica Dominicana. Empieza aqui cuando no sepas que preguntar o que fuente oficial usar.

do-gov-data.description: Orquestar una investigacion de asuntos publicos dominicanos combinando varias fuentes oficiales. Usar cuando la pregunta cruza contrataciones, presupuesto, leyes o jurisprudencia.

do-procurement-watch.description: Monitorear y analizar contrataciones publicas dominicanas (DGCP): licitaciones por institucion o rubro, proveedores y montos. Usar para preguntas de compras del Estado.

do-spend-accountability.description: Analizar el gasto publico dominicano: presupuestado frente a ejecutado, por institucion y periodo. Usar para preguntas de rendicion de cuentas o ejecucion presupuestaria.

do-legislative-scan.description: Rastrear la actividad legislativa dominicana en ambas camaras: estado y cronologia de un proyecto de ley, y votaciones nominales. Usar para seguimiento legislativo.

do-consolidated-law.description: Localizar y citar leyes, decretos, resoluciones y reglamentos dominicanos desde 1844 en la fuente oficial consolidada. Usar cuando se necesite el texto o la cita exacta.

do-caselaw-watch.description: Investigar jurisprudencia dominicana: sentencias de la Suprema Corte de Justicia y del Tribunal Constitucional. Usar para precedentes y criterios judiciales.

do-policy-landscape.description: Construir el panorama completo de un tema de politica publica dominicana cruzando todas las fuentes oficiales. Usar para un brief de contexto amplio, no para un dato puntual.

getting-started.description: Day-0 setup and orientation for this plugin inside Codex -- confirm the MCP servers are reachable, learn how to invoke a skill, and find the right guide. Use when someone is new, asks how to get started, or a skill reports its server is unreachable.

excluded._comment: Deliberately NOT shipped to Codex, with the reason. Recorded here so each omission is a decision rather than an oversight.
excluded.asset-editor: asset-broker is OAuth-gated and deliberately not declared for Codex (operator decision 2026-08-31); no server behind it in a Codex session.
excluded.format-workspace-memory: Reads and writes the client's SharePoint workspace record through workspace-scoped tools that only exist in a Cowork workspace session. Would dead-end in Codex CLI.
